in_sanskrit.name: Shiva
in_sanskrit.meaning: The Auspicious One, God of Destruction and Creation
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is auspicious, the destroyer of evil, and the creator of the universe. He is the God of Gods and the Supreme Being in Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: शिवतेज
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव (Shiva) - गOD OF DESTROYER AND CREATOR, तेज (Tej) - RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE. SO, शिवतेज (Shivtej) MEANS 'GOD SHIVA WITH RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE'.

in_tamil.name: சிவதேஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிவ (Shiva) - கடினம் ஒப்பிய கோப்போத்திரவன் (God of Destruction and Creation), தேஜ (Tej) - காலையில் அழகிய விழுங்கல் (Radiance or Brilliance). SO, சிவதேஜ (Shivtej) MEANS 'GOD SHIVA WITH RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE'.

in_telugu.name: శివటేజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శివ (Shiva) - దేశిక శద్ద దేశియళ్ళేయేదేశ (God of Destruction and Creation), టేజ (Tej) - ఆశచరిపోయేదేశ (Radiance or Brilliance). SO, శివటేజ (Shivtej) MEANS 'GOD SHIVA WITH RADIANCE OR BRILLIANCE'.

in_marathi.name: Shivtej
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivtej हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shiv Tej is a name that is derived from the combination of two words - 'Shiv' and 'Tej'. 'Shiv' is the name of the Hindu god of destruction and is considered the supreme god of the Hindu pantheon. 'Tej' means 'victory' or 'power'. Therefore, Shiv Tej can be interpreted as 'Shiva's Victory' or 'Shiva's Power'.
